thread:
mira: Heads-up: rolling mosaic-int8 canary (canary-921) to dedicated pool. Seeing funcall parse failures on tool outputs ~1.9% over last 2h, mostly truncated arrays and broken escapes.

cesar: paste a raw failing snippet + canary id?

mira: canary-921. mirror replay:```
{"op":"append","rows":[{"id":10,"txt":"start"},{"id":11,"txt":"multi\\nline"},{"id":12,"txt":"unterminated\\"}
```
stream ended inside a backslash-escape; parser: "Unterminated string".

ingest-bot: alert: funcall_parse_error rate mosaic-int8 = 1.9% -> 2.6% over 30m. threshold 0.5% breached.

noah: token tail from mirror for one failing request: `tokens: [..., 134, 9, 0, 58]` where `0` looks like control. also saw comments like `// note` injected by the model in some shards.

cesar: guess: quant path inserting control/eos tokens that confuse streaming boundaries + gateway combiner merging chunks by arrival. short-term mitigations:
- suffix-checker at gateway for toolcall routes (buffer if last char is open delimiter or trailing backslash)
- increase retry attempts for canary toolcalls 3->6 with jitter
- restrict ensemble routing for toolcalls to single shard for now

mira: quick A/B: enabled suffix-checker for canary-tool routes for 40m. errors dropped 1.9% -> 0.35%. p50 latency +30ms. metrics: `errors:[1.9,0.35], p50_ms:[110,140]`.

jin: nice. is the suffix-checker just a cheap 128B buffer and delimiter check?

cesar: yep. checks for trailing `\"`, single trailing backslash, open brackets `{[`, or trailing comma+newline heuristics. very low overhead.

noah: follow-ups:
1) keep suffix-checker scoped to toolcall routes only
2) collect all repaired/truncated examples and log token streams + shard provenance in ticket CAN-4510
3) cesar to run a local int8 repro with token-logger to confirm whether quantizer emits control token `0` mid-string
4) if issues persist, temporarily route toolcalls to fp16 for mosaic until we fix combiner/tokenizer

mira: owners: @cesar token analysis + local repro, @mira rollout/metrics, @jin gate changes in canary infra. I'll file CAN-4510 and attach mirror traces. follow-up in 3h with 1h snapshot.

ingest-bot: note: automated rollback policy will trigger if funcall_parse_error_rate > 1.0% for 15m on production routes.

cesar: small idea: if suffix-checker latency unacceptable, implement targeted escape-aware buffering (only when last token ends inside a quoted string). cheaper than full json-wrap.

mira: agree. please prototype. thanks all.
